title: pinus wallichiana subsp. manangensis
intro: Pinus wallichiana subsp. manangensis, commonly known as Himalayan white pine or Western Himalayan pine, is a subspecies of pine tree found primarily in the Himalayan region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the ability to relieve respiratory issues and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Pinus wallichiana subsp. manangensis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant properties, which help to soothe and calm the respiratory system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its health benefits and medicinal properties.
